Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary joined with compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: document CHEMBL1129278 via compound_records.doc_id = docs.chembl_id and compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
